entries.meaning: Wrap it up / get to the point; short for 'just put the fries in the bag'
entries.example: Bro been talking ten minutes, fries.
entries.region_detail: Gen Alpha usage; origin a 2022 Facebook meme
entries.notes: Often with 🍟✌️ emoji. Only one solid source so far; re-check UD/KYM.

entries.meaning: Keep it to yourself / lay low; also 'calm down, stop being loud'
entries.example: I got a new situationship but I'm quiet on the creek about it.
entries.region_detail: Miami (from Saucy Santana, Love & Hip Hop: Miami); spread to Chicago per r/Chiraqology thread
entries.notes: Two meanings in use (keep quiet vs. tell someone to hush). Vice 2026-09-28; UD entries from 2026-07-13.

entries.meaning: Fair enough; accepting someone's point, often with the 👌 hand
entries.example: You can't come 'cause you broke? Fairs.
entries.region_detail: UK slang origin (KYM region: United Kingdom); went viral in US mid-2026
entries.notes: Origin UK, now national/online in US kids' speech.

entries.meaning: Cheap, fake, low-quality thing that tries to look high-end
entries.example: That chain is polyester, he got it off a cart.

entries.meaning: A big AI-generated doc, deck, or code someone dumps on you to deal with
entries.example: He dropped a 40-page slop grenade in the group chat and dipped.
entries.notes: UD Word of the Day only; no second source yet. Watch.

entries.meaning: Smug brush-off when someone asks you a hard question
entries.example: Ask him where the money went and he hit you with 'relax, pal.'
entries.region_detail: Madison, WI (UW-Madison student on WISN 12 News clip); not one of our city buckets
entries.notes: Catchphrase from a news clip about a hazing case, not organic street slang. Short shelf life likely.

entries.example: Yeah crodie, let's run that game tonight.
entries.notes: Green Line (2026-09-26) uses it in an example; UD says Rexdale origin; Wiktionary: synonym of brodie.

entries.meaning: Let's do it / go ahead with it
entries.example: Food spot after the game? Run that.
entries.region_detail: Toronto (The Green Line says it's not Toronto-only but is common there)
entries.notes: Also heard elsewhere; regional tag is soft.

entries.example: Me and my croski been tight since Year 7.
entries.region_detail: Wiktionary tags Multicultural London English; UD says Toronto
entries.notes: Region sources disagree (London vs Toronto). Same family as crodie. Wiktionary added it 2026-08-01.

entries.meaning: 'That thing is good' ('gas' = good), said like the viral kid
entries.example: Tried that new wing spot. Dat bih gah.
entries.region_detail: Viral TikTok/X video, late May 2026; KYM region United States
entries.notes: Comes from 'that bitch gas'. Profanity, so filter by app content rating.

entries.meaning: Pretending / posing / being inauthentic (figurative extension of live-action role-play)
entries.example: He's not a finance guy, he's just larping LinkedIn with a rented suit.
entries.region_detail: Online youth / Gen Alpha–Z comment culture
entries.notes: Coinage older; strong Sep 2026 news spike (USA Today, Vice, MW, Euronews). Also 'larp'.

entries.meaning: Nose-pinch + hand-wave dance/reaction for something foul, or as a celebration dance; tied to Scuba Juke (It Stank)
entries.example: He walked in smelling like smoke and the whole group hit the scuba.
entries.region_detail: Chicago origin (Desean Hawk Logan-Russell / h5wk); national via TikTok/NFL; some early clips tagged #dmvtiktok
entries.notes: KYM + Vice; googling spike Aug–Sep 2026 — allowed as spiking.

entries.meaning: Put-down for something that feels fake cheap copied exaggerated or hard to believe (not literally AI-made)
entries.example: That bootleg phone case? That's so AI.
entries.notes: Single primary source; also heard as 'that's AI'. Confidence discount.

entries.meaning: Someone who looks like you (or a known person) but worse / 'chopped' (uglier off-brand lookalike); chopped + doppelganger
entries.example: That's not him, that's his choppelganger from the food court.
entries.notes: KYM + Wiktionary + UD + explainers. First seen >90d; still circulating.

entries.meaning: Doing things on purpose to look cool / collect aura (often called out as try-hard)
entries.example: Sunglasses indoors at brunch is pure aura farming.
entries.region_detail: Anime/TikTok; Pacu Jalur boat-kid clip often cited mid-2025
entries.notes: MW + Brewtiful + Euronews. Older coinage; Sep 2026 search spike.

entries.meaning: A group (often women) who dig through someone's digital footprint to vet them
entries.example: Before the date she assembled Galantir and found his old forum posts.
entries.notes: UD Word of the Day only; no second source. Watch.

entries.example: That fit is chopped, change before we go out.
entries.region_detail: MW credits AAVE; some commentators specify NYC/NJ; now national youth speech
entries.notes: Not brand-new; youth spike ~2025. Soft region conflict (origin vs national). Pairs with choppelganger.

entries.meaning: PlayStation 5 (Spanish 'el cinco' = the five); joke memes about robbers grabbing it
entries.example: They can take the TV, just don't let them leave with el cinco.
entries.notes: Also 'the 5'. First seen Jan 2026; inventory keep.

entries.meaning: Dense compressed technical English associated with Claude / coding agents (gated on, load-bearing, blast radius)
entries.example: His Slack update was so Claudish nobody outside eng could parse it.
entries.notes: Waterloo + Etymology Nerd (2026-09-19). Weak for street Bars; tech-adjacent watch.
